    Function post

    • post(
          data: StatsPayload | CommandsPayload,
          token: string,
          baseUrl?: string,
      ): Promise<any>

      Posts either bot telemetry statistics (StatsPayload) or application commands (CommandsPayload) to the Xernerx Suite API (https://api.xernerx.com).

      Automatically dispatches to postCommands when a commands array is present on data, or to postStats otherwise.

      Parameters

      • data: StatsPayload | CommandsPayload

        Bot telemetry payload (StatsPayload) or application commands payload (CommandsPayload).

      • token: string

        Xernerx Suite API bearer token (Bearer <token>).

      • OptionalbaseUrl: string

        Optional custom Xernerx Suite API base URL (defaults to 'https://api.xernerx.com').

      Returns Promise<any>

      A promise resolving to the parsed JSON response from the Xernerx Suite API.

      Throws

      When data.id is missing or the Xernerx Suite API responds with a non-2xx HTTP status.

      Example

      import { post, Terminal } from 'xernerx';

      export class TelemetrySync extends Terminal {
      	constructor() {
      		super({ scope: 'XS' });
      	}

      	async run() {
      		await post({ id: 'YOUR_BOT_ID', guildCount: 150, userCount: 25000 }, process.env.XERNERX_TOKEN!);
      		this.info('Synced bot telemetry to Xernerx!');
      	}
      }

      new TelemetrySync().run();
